ActivityId.description:
Activity identifier.

 This is an identifier, not a credential. Generation and authorization
 belong to the caller. Parsing rejects aliases rather than normalizing them.

schemaJson.description:
A complete JSON Schema 2020-12 document encoded as text for editor use.
It contains definitions and constraints, never configuration values.

propertyNames.description:
Stable node identifier, independent of its addresses and keys.

 This is an identifier, not a credential. Generation and authorization
 belong to the caller. Parsing rejects aliases rather than normalizing them.

Count.description: A nonnegative item count bounded for lossless JSON arithmetic.

name.description: Raw input. Apply getAuthOptions.networkNameRules; padding is allowed.

oneOf.description: Null only when secure request-ID generation itself is unavailable.

JoinLinkId.description:
Network join-link record identifier; not the joining secret.

 This is an identifier, not a credential. Generation and authorization

ListenerUpdate.description:
Same protocol fields as a declaration, with secret omission interpreted as
keep only while updating the same resource. New resources have no predecessor.

MembershipRole.description: A user's role within one network; this does not grant instance privileges.

total.description:
Current visible count within the cursor's original creation bounds.
Recomputed on every page; permission loss can reduce this value.

Current visible count within the cursor's original creation bound.
Removed members disappear and reduce total on subsequent pages.

forbidControlCharacters.description: Reject every Unicode General_Category=Cc character in raw input.

trim.description:
Unicode White_Space: U+0009..000D, 0020, 0085, 00A0, 1680,
2000..200A, 2028, 2029, 202F, 205F, 3000. U+FEFF is not trimmed.
Raw input Cc rejection happens before trimming (including edge controls).

NodeId.description:
Stable node identifier, independent of its addresses and keys.

 This is an identifier, not a credential. Generation and authorization
 belong to the caller. Parsing rejects aliases rather than normalizing them.

OuterSocket.description: Outer transport socket classification; never a business access decision.

Port.description: A nonzero TCP/UDP port. Successful validation says nothing about availability.

PositiveDuration.description: Positive canonical decimal with ms/s/m/h; total must fit u64 milliseconds. Unit spelling is preserved. Consumers enforce resource and lease limits separately.

 This is an identifier, not a credential. Generation and authorization
 belong to the caller. Parsing rejects aliases rather than normalizing them.

name.description: Raw input. Apply getAuthOptions.networkNameRules, not String.length.

Request identifier.

 This is an identifier, not a credential. Generation and authorization
 belong to the caller. Parsing rejects aliases rather than normalizing them.

SecretString.description: Serialization is secret-bearing and requires protected storage.

SessionId.description:
User session record identifier; not the session token.

 This is an identifier, not a credential. Generation and authorization
 belong to the caller. Parsing rejects aliases rather than normalizing them.

SessionIssuedResponse.description: First delivery only. Session reads never return the token.

requiredCapability.description: Controller configuration support does not attest an Agent build's support.

TransportProtocol.description: Protocol keys, not a Controller enabled catalogue or a Node support report.

UserId.description:
Stable user identifier.

 This is an identifier, not a credential. Generation and authorization
 belong to the caller. Parsing rejects aliases rather than normalizing them.

UserView.description: A user account; this view grants no network or instance privileges.

email.description: Canonical login identifier, not proof of email ownership.

Version.description: A positive record version, distinct from a configuration revision.

VlessStream.description:
Concrete VLESS stream encapsulation. Dialer selection such as `auto` is not
an encapsulation, and neither variant means that its runtime is installed.

WebSocketHeaders.description: Additional WebSocket headers, preserving casing. HTTP token names cannot override Host, Connection, Upgrade, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding or Sec-WebSocket-*, ignoring ASCII case. Handshake and HTTP message framing fields belong to the upgrade implementation. Names must also be unique ignoring ASCII case (semantic validation).

additionalProperties.description:
Header text preserved verbatim, including empty values and horizontal tabs.
CR/LF, NUL and other Unicode control characters (except HTAB) are rejected.
Unicode text is represented as UTF-8; protocol-specific semantic constraints
and request/header size limits remain the consumer's responsibility.

propertyNames.description:
Case-preserving HTTP token for an additional WebSocket header.
Host, Connection, Upgrade, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding, and every
Sec-WebSocket-* name are reserved, ignoring ASCII case. Handshake and HTTP
message framing fields belong to the upgrade implementation. No Unicode
header names are allowed by HTTP token syntax.

WebSocketPath.description:
Exact path, preserved without URL decoding or normalization.
Unicode is permitted, but whitespace, C0/C1 controls, query and fragment
delimiters are not. Percent escapes are not decoded by this value type.

WireSecret.description:
Secret wire string. Serialization and borrowing are explicit; Debug, Display,
and Clone are deliberately unavailable. The owned buffer is wiped on drop.
